dossier.identity: gyro-tailed rail skirmisher who sews pink lines through the lane and skips out of every reply~ :3
dossier.selectionRationale: a mid-range pierce-and-reposition striker: where aria's single arrow and sol's fixed beam punish stillness, ravel rewards moving three metres between shots and threading enemies that line up, a loop none of the current strikers cover.
dossier.weaponConcept: prism rail (high-velocity electromagnetic rail rifle with variable zoom scope, recoil coil array, capacitor pack, synthetic-gel coolant channel, modular penetration rail frame and a rear tail gyro)

lore.backstory: former courier-lane rail-gun tuner who learned that distance is only a number if you can close it with a line~ uwu. she wired a gyroscopic tail to her recoil coil so every shot stitches her forward instead of throwing her back.
lore.syndicateRecord: suspected in the "seven-needle" incident where a single rail shot pinned a convoy's lead and rear vehicles to the same overpass.
lore.psychProfile: teasing and endlessly composed, calls enemies "strangers" until they stop moving xo.
lore.combatQuote: “distance is just an invitation, darling~ faster scars make a brighter tomorrow :3”

forms.name: stitch ray

forms.name: double thread
forms.description: The lance pierces one extra enemy (2 targets) and marks every enemy it strikes for 2 s (60 ticks).

forms.name: triple thread
forms.description: Three parallel lances 0.9 m (90 cm) apart, each piercing one extra enemy for 70% damage; an enemy struck by two or more lances is rooted for 0.8 s (24 ticks).

iconFamily.subject: a bold stitched thread line through a single chunky gyro tail loop
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Ravel. Theme: prism thread. Subject: a bold stitched thread line through a single chunky gyro tail loop. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
